Red sits within ~2 m of the centre of the light strip between the curb/W.P. dashed line and the south building line (the old E.S. Canal street, on the parkway paste-over). Blue runs ~4 m north. Edge reading is approximate.

In 1904 Elder St splits around the Findlay Market house between Elm and Pleasant (ELDER is printed on both carriageways). Red is a level segment, not parallel to the frontages: ~13 m north of the street-envelope centre at the Elm end and ~4 m north at the Pleasant end. It also doesn't meet the adjoining red Elder segment at Elm (~15 m jump). Blue W Elder follows the 1904 north carriageway.
move: south 8 m (13 m at Elm end, 4 m at Pleasant end; rotate parallel to frontages)

note: Red is centred on 1904 Moore St (40') south of E Liberty and follows the real 1904 ~15 m westward jog along Liberty to the Moore St north of Liberty. OSM Moore pieces stop short at the widened E Liberty.
OSM Central Parkway runs along the south bank/towpath of the Miami Canal and through a foundry building. There was no street on that line in 1904.
Bank Street. OSM Mallory runs along the north building line of the 1904 Bank St (50'); red Bank is centred ~8-10 m south of it.

Freeman Avenue. The right-hand sheet prints FREEMAN AV straight N-S under the blue (W.P. lines, addresses 556/538). Red Freeman follows the adjoining left-hand sheet's diagonal FREEMAN AV: ~5 m off at Sloo, growing to ~35-40 m in the south. The sheets disagree, so red Freeman probably needs re-tracing to the right-hand sheet. The south-end ramp branches cross 1904 rail/yard land.
OSM Elizabeth St runs along lot lines and through 1904 buildings between Linn and Cutter. No alley on the sheet.
Unnamed 10' alley through block 5 between the Colerain Av and Kindel Av rear lots, under the blue. The E-W alley at its north end (OSM Beloit Alley) is also missing from the basin.
to: E-W alley north of the Pork House (OSM Beloit Alley)

note: BOGEN ALLEY is printed through block 6 between Kindel Av and Freeman Av, with 10' at both ends, under the blue (OSM Kimpell Alley). The E-W alley at its north end is also missing from the basin.
to: E-W alley at the north end of the block (printed ALLEY, south of Central Av)

note: OSM Gest St runs through the H. & S. Pogue warehouse and the 717-726 rows. There was no street there in 1904.
OSM Genessee St runs through 1904 rear lots and buildings between Wise Alley and Betts St.
OSM Western Av, south of W Liberty, cuts diagonally through 1904 buildings and lots of the Faulkner-Freeman block (triangle building, 1004-1002, garage/plumber).
OSM Van Meter St cuts diagonally through 1904 dwellings and lots of block 5 between E 6th and Baum.
OSM Mallory runs north of the 1904 Bank St frontage, through the slaughter house, sheep shed, cattle pens, chill rooms and the 1200-1220 buildings (modern widening).
OSM Dalton Av, north of Findlay, crosses the open field of the Cincinnati Base Ball Park inside the grandstand. No street in 1904.
OSM Monastery St, south of Baum, cuts diagonally through 1904 dwellings and E 5th St lots. In 1904 Monastery ended at Baum.

A narrow (~3-4 m) unnamed passage runs west from Broadway between the Undertaker/office row and the Parish House/Fourth St & Broadway Apts, to the N-S alley by Christ Church. No name or width printed (sheet carries later paste-overs).
to: N-S alley beside Christ Church Sunday School

note: The OSM Gest St diagonal cuts across 1904 lots: the filling-station lot, the 956-950 W Court rear lots, then across W Court into the 945-943 dwellings.
OSM Langston St runs through 1904 private stable and sale-stable buildings in block 3 and onto the canal towpath.

Butler Street. Red Butler is centred on the 1904 Butler St next to the Frankfort spice company building. OSM Butler runs ~8-12 m southwest across a 1904 open lot (realigned). Could arguably be read as B2.
This OSM W Court St segment runs diagonally south from Gest through 1904 buildings and rear yards of the 909-911 Gest lots. No street in 1904.

The block north of E Liberty is a blank outline on this sheet (drawn in Vol. 2). Its Liberty frontage line is unbroken where the OSM alley meets it, unlike the alley and street gaps at B104/B114. North of ~20 m there is no sheet coverage, so this is only moderately sure.
OSM Oneida Alley runs along the west wall of the Livingston bank building and through the 114-116 W 7th buildings. No alley on the 1904 sheet.

North of E Liberty the sheet shows only blank block outlines. A ~6 m gap between two of them runs north from E Liberty, exactly under the blue, so an alley was there. Nothing printed. The north end runs past sheet coverage.
The flagged N-S stretch of OSM Ravine St crosses 1904 lots (sheds by 401 Byron) and Byron St down to the Miami Canal edge. In 1904 Ravine was the diagonal red street to the northeast.

The sheet shows a ~15 m street with a W.P. line running north from E Liberty between two block outlines, under the blue. No name printed within coverage; a 50' at the corner may refer to Liberty instead. The north end runs past sheet coverage.
OSM Genevaview St curves through the 1904 dwellings at 734-730 Betts (north side) down to Betts St.
